historical_record.description: The corner lot, 60.8 feet on Laguna Street and 137.5 feet on Clay, held a three-unit, four-level apartment building with five parking spaces.
The City Planning Commission unanimously approved a fourth, two-bedroom flat in a ground-level addition at the building's southwest corner (Resolution 7618).

The Board of Permit Appeals overruled the Department of Public Works' denial of a permit to alter the building at 2151 Laguna Street, with stipulations that sprinkling be provided for the garage and lower floors of occupancy and that approved products of combustion devices be installed in living units, connected to a manually operated or automatic local fire alarm system.
